summary: Frontend-only testing of /justicesquare page. All key features verified: hero (title/subtitle, 3 stats, 4 quick-jump buttons), NEWS section (8 cards + filters + external links with target=_blank), REPORTS (6 cards + 7 filter pills + links), INFOGRAFIKEN (5 tabs, chart switches, tooltip on hover), MULTIMEDIA (6 cards + 5 filters + external links), USEFUL LINKS (10 buttons), editorial guideline, and mobile responsiveness at 390px. No React runtime errors on the page.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero stat data-testids resolve as 'hero-stat-stat-arrests', 'hero-stat-stat-ecthr', 'hero-stat-stat-reports' because template is `hero-stat-${st.id}` and ids are prefixed with 'stat-'. Works but has redundant 'stat-' prefix. Consider using indices or stripping prefix for cleaner testids.
JusticeSquarePage.tsx is likely a large file; consider splitting each section (News/Reports/Infographics/Multimedia/UsefulLinks) into subcomponents to improve maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: JusticeSquare page fully functional. 37/37 UI assertions passed. Hero stats testids are 'hero-stat-stat-arrests|stat-ecthr|stat-reports' (double prefix). Chart tooltip works via hover on rect/circle/path inside SVG. External links correctly open in new tab. Pre-existing CSP/HMR console errors unrelated to JusticeSquare are ignored.
